dct_creator_sm: Laliberte, L.W. (University of Alberta Libraries, UAL).
dct_description_sm: The file contained in this study is composed of .csv files related to a series of xsl transformation performed on OCR scans of the 1911/12 List of licensed elevators and warehouses in the Manitoba Grain Inspection Division to generate the .csv from file. The code utilized in the xsl transformation can be found on GitHub.
